# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in `/AGENTS.md` and `docs/07-development-governance/AI_DEVELOPMENT_RULES.md`.

Read the relevant product/module specification before generating code. Preserve the approved architecture: .NET API, WPF POS, Flutter staff app, Next.js owner portal, PostgreSQL RLS and encrypted SQLite offline storage. Use modular monolith boundaries, full double-entry accounting, global jurisdiction packs and safe offline synchronization. Never bypass tenant authorization, audit, idempotency or tests.
